tools/check_glossary.mjs must be run with --applied once a batch has been applied: without it the checker resolves map keys against the post-apply tree, where the old keys no longer exist, and reports errors=172 (every entry). With --applied it reads the batch rollback copy and reports errors=0 warnings=171, which is what this sidecar records.
